mutations.label: the create stops storing the labels, so a labelled address reads back without them, which is #703 verbatim
the view stops serving the labels it holds, so get and list answer without them while the store has them
the update stops applying the labels it is sent, so a second apply that changes them converges on nothing
an update that does not name labels clears them, which is the absent-versus-empty confusion of #404 on this resource
the reset list grows labels back, a field the API description does not declare resettable on an elastic IP
